title: FTP server restarts after being stopped when app is closed from Recents

full_report.title: FTP server restarts after being stopped when app is closed from Recents
full_report.observed_behavior: On the FTP server screen, if the user toggles the Status switch to OFF (stop the FTP server), then presses the system Back button to leave the screen and dismisses the app from the Android Recents screen, the FTP server restarts (turns back on) even though it was stopped.
full_report.expected_behavior: The FTP server should stay stopped (should not restart automatically) after stopping it and closing the app.
full_report.steps_to_reproduce:
1. Open Material Files.
2. On the Android permission prompt, tap "Allow".
3. In the file list screen, tap the "Navigate up" button.
4. From the navigation drawer/list, tap "FTP server".
5. On the FTP server screen, tap the "Status" switch to turn it OFF (stop the server).
6. Press the system Back button to leave the FTP server screen.
7. In Android Recents, dismiss the Material Files app (swipe it away / tap the dismiss icon).
8. Observe that the FTP server restarts (turns back on) even though it was stopped.

ground_truth.info_elements_gt:
Buggy Behavior: the server restarts automatically
Triggering GUI Interaction: stops the FTP server and then closes the app
Triggering Screen Reference: FTP server screen
Correct Behavior: The FTP server should remain stopped
